propositions: Add a packaged T15 evaluation spec fixture that covers deployed-service applicable/pass cases with runtime risks (boot, authentication, authorization, connectivity, readiness) and scoped cleanup of experiment-created artifacts only.
Add applicable/finding cases for destructive cleanup patterns (dropping pre-existing tables, wiping shared buckets) and slow delivery-loop-only feedback scenarios.
Add not-applicable/pass cases for app-only, library-only, CLI-only, docs-only, health-route, and S2/S3 boundary conditions.
Extend unit test registration to validate the T15 spec passes strict-clean schema, balanced dataset, registered scorers, and gold-set checks through the public eval loader.
Extend T15-specific tests to pin case identifiers, applicability matrix, scorer names, and assert semantic payload content.
Document T15 application-scope false positives as regression guards in the observed-false-positives ledger.
